summary.text: Paeonian whom Achilles slew in the river-bank slaughter when the company of Asteropaeus fled before the son of Peleus.

story.text: After Asteropaeus fell beneath Achilles' Pelian ash, the Paeonians broke along Scamander's banks; among them Aenius was slain with Thersilochus, Mydon, Astypylus, Mnesus, Thrasius, and Ophelestes before the River rose in wrath against the son of Peleus.
